description:
https://store.playstation.com/concept/231261/

Conan Exiles Enhanced is a FREE upgrade to Conan Exiles, coming to PlayStation 5 in early 2027. The upgrade will be available to all current and future owners of Conan Exiles on PlayStation. Built in Unreal Engine 5, Conan Exiles Enhanced brings eight years of incredible survival content into a fully upgraded experience with dramatically improved visuals, enhanced performance, modern rendering technology and for the first time connecting the Exiled Lands to the expansion Isle of Siptah*. The update revitalizes the brutal world of Conan Exiles, delivering a deeper level of immersion for both new players and long-time fans.

#ps5 #ps5games #conanexiles
title: Conan Exiles Enhanced - Announcement Trailer | PS5 Games

The Séance of Blake Manor is a supernatural detective mystery, set in 1897 Ireland, where you investigate the disappearance of a young woman in a remote hotel full of secrets and other-worldly occurrences. Available now on PlayStation 5.


As Private Investigator Declan Ward, you’ll interview and interrogate an eclectic group of suspects to learn more about their motivations and unearth any clues they may be hiding. 

Record the details in Declan’s journal, then use your findings to uncover the truth about Blake Manor and the mysterious séance that has brought these unusual guests together.

#ps5 #ps5games
title: The Séance of Blake Manor - Launch Trailer | PS5 Games

Farm life gets warmer and fluffier: Beans & Alpacas for Farming Simulator 25 takes you to Catuaí, a new farming region in South America. Coffee & bananas introduce new cultivation systems and more production chains: Start harvesting and produce coffee capsules, banana milk, Tiramisu and cake! 

Beans & Alpacas also introduces more than 25+ machines and hand tools to lead and shear your alpacas. Explore a new region, gather new materials to repaint your farmhouse, and find the dinosaur bones!
